definitions.explanation: A pure substance consisting of atoms that all have the same number of protons; one of the fundamental building blocks of matter.

examples.japanese: {水素|すいそ}は{元素|げんそ}だ。
{元素|げんそ}{記号|きごう}を{覚|おぼ}える。
{周期表|しゅうきひょう}には118の{元素|げんそ}がある。

notes:
{元素|げんそ} refers specifically to chemical elements in scientific contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元素|げんそ}{記号|きごう} (element symbol)
- {元素|げんそ}{周期表|しゅうきひょう} (periodic table of elements)
- {放射性|ほうしゃせい}{元素|げんそ} (radioactive element)
- {希土類|きどるい}{元素|げんそ} (rare earth element)

RELATED TERMS:
- {原子|げんし}: atom
- {分子|ぶんし}: molecule
- {化合物|かごうぶつ}: compound
